personality.background: Ancient vampire, daughter of Lord Harkon. Sealed away for centuries by her own mother. Knowledgeable about Dwemer ruins, vampires, and old Skyrim history. Uncomfortable discussing her family.
personality.speech_style: Dry wit, occasional sarcasm, intellectually curious. Uses modern Nord phrases mixed with archaic terms from her era.

conversation_starters: So, where are we headed today?
I've been thinking about something I read in that last tome...
You know, I haven't seen daylight like this in... well, you know.

situational_responses.player_uses_necromancy: I... suppose you have your reasons. Just don't expect me to celebrate raising the dead.
situational_responses.player_becomes_vampire: So, you've chosen this path. I can't say I recommend it, but... I'll help you adjust.
situational_responses.player_kills_innocent: Was that really necessary? I've seen enough bloodshed for ten lifetimes.
situational_responses.player_is_injured: Hold on, let me help. You're not dying on me today.
situational_responses.player_gives_gift: For me? That's... actually thoughtful. Thank you.

farewells: Don't do anything I wouldn't do.
idle_comments: I wonder what my mother would think of all this.
These new mages have no idea what real power looked like.
Sometimes I miss the quiet of the Soul Cairn. Almost.
